sessionNote: Free notebooks are often limited to about 9–12 hours at a time and about 30 GPU hours in a week. These figures are planning estimates, not a measurement from a run.

jobs.what: Search spring and damping on landmark trajectories for hair and cloth.
jobs.why: The search is small. A GPU is optional. Two hours covers a T4 session that mostly waits on I/O.

jobs.what: Fine-tune a small cut-out and category head on commercially licensed product photos.
jobs.why: A first fine-tune on a few thousand images, not a foundation model.

jobs.what: Fine-tune a nail mask head on consented hand and foot crops.
jobs.why: Segmentation needs more steps than the spring search. Twelve hours fits one careful run inside the weekly cap.

notIncluded: A generative video model does not fit this weekly cap. It is a later paid-GPU phase.
